name: model-fallback
title: Fall back to a stronger model when the tool rejects the call

origin.source: LangGraph how-to: handle tool calling errors (fallback to a better model)

comparison.purpose: A cheap model drafts a weather tool call; the tool validates the city names, and only a rejected call goes to a stronger model, which gets exactly one try before the run ends in failed. The fallback ladder is states and a choice guard, so which model answered is visible in the path.

starters: Get the weather for San Francisco, Boston and Tokyo
What's the weather like in London and New York?
